title: Poached Nectarine Elixir
description: A refreshing summer dessert made with poached nectarine and a hint of sweetness.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine sliced nectarines and sugar.
Add water and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes, or until nectarines are tender.
Strain poaching liquid and discard solids.
Stir in lemon juice and light elixir (if using).
Serve warm or chilled, garnished with additional nectarine slices if desired.
If desired, chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.
